description.text: The fourth Black & White set, released on 8 February 2012 with 103 cards: 99 and four secret Shiny reprints of Emboar, Zoroark, Chandelure and Hydreigon. It was the first Black & White set with Pokémon from outside Unova and brought back Pokémon-EX, strong Pokémon that give up two Prize cards: six of them, among them Mewtwo-EX, Reshiram-EX and Zekrom-EX, each also as a full-art card with an etched finish. Its theme decks, Explosive Edge and Voltage Vortex, are built around Reshiram and Zekrom.

description.text: A smooth-style cosmos holofoil copy from a Black & White Two Pack Blister of December 2013. Each blister held two Black & White Series booster packs, a coin and three cosmos holofoil cards: Cobalion, Terrakion and Virizion, or Articuno, Zapdos and Moltres. Articuno, Zapdos and Moltres came again in the XY Kanto Two Pack Blister of 2015, with two booster packs and a Pikachu coin. The Plasma Freeze Single Pack Blister copy of 2013 is on the earlier, pixel-style holofoil. It isn't found in booster packs.

description.text: A test print of the full-art Mewtwo-EX with no text at all: the art, the type symbol and the empty name and attack bars are printed, but no name, HP, attacks or card number, and the back is blank white. It comes from uncut sheets on which the full-art Mewtwo-EX and Regigigas-EX alternate. Several such sheets had been in collectors' hands for years before some were cut up, so the cards were cut after they left the printer, not at the factory. CGC labels them "Next Destinies Test Print Without Text", and by April 2025 its population report counted 363 of the two together.

sources.title: Elite Fourum: CGC Without Text Test Prints
